title: Verify account balance is displayed correctly
description: Positive test for account balance display
preconditions: User is authenticated and has an active bank account

steps.action: Log in to the banking portal

steps.expected_result: Account balance is displayed with current amount

expected_outcome: Account balance matches the actual balance in the system
given: An authenticated user with an active bank account
when: The user navigates to the account summary page
then: The system displays the current account balance with recent transactions

title: Validate balance display for suspended account
description: Negative test for suspended account access
preconditions: User is authenticated but account is suspended

steps.action: Log in to the banking portal

expected_outcome: System shows account suspended message instead of balance
given: An authenticated user with a suspended bank account
when: The user navigates to the account summary page
then: The system displays an account suspended notice with contact information

title: Verify fund transfer between own accounts
description: Positive test for internal fund transfer
preconditions: User is authenticated with sufficient balance in source account

steps.action: Navigate to the fund transfer page

expected_outcome: Funds are transferred and both account balances are updated
given: An authenticated user with sufficient balance in the source account
when: The user initiates a transfer between own accounts and confirms
then: The system processes the transfer and updates both account balances

title: Validate transfer exceeding available balance
description: Negative test for insufficient funds transfer
preconditions: User is authenticated with limited balance in source account

steps.action: Navigate to the fund transfer page

steps.expected_result: Amount field shows the entered value

expected_outcome: System rejects the transfer and displays insufficient funds message
given: An authenticated user with limited balance in the source account
when: The user attempts to transfer an amount exceeding the available balance
then: The system rejects the transfer and displays an insufficient funds error
